2608.13221.title: TsuGO: Probing Search Efficiency in LLM Reasoning via Go Life-and-Death Problems
2608.13221.paper_summary: The evaluation of LLM reasoning is moving from final-answer accuracy to process-level assessment, yet existing methods still fail to capture how models plan reasoning paths and allocate reasoning resources--that is, how they organize search. Prior process-level methods focus on the coherence and redundancy of chain-of-thought (CoT), and most benchmark tasks have a single objective solvable by static capabilities such as derivation and tool use, leaving search organization unmeasured. We introduce TsuGO, a process-level reasoning benchmark for evaluating Search Efficiency in LLM reasoning through Go life-and-death problems. These problems provide closed and verifiable solution spaces with an inherent adversarial structure, making candidate generation, response checking, branch comparison, and backtracking necessary parts of reasoning rather than incidental trace patterns. By constraining the solution space, TsuGO disentangles domain knowledge from search organization, parses CoT into a structured search tree, and reports Search Efficiency together with Token Efficiency and other diagnostic metrics and visualizations. Experiments show that current LLMs remain far from stable tsumego solving: stronger models succeed by finding the correct candidate earlier and sustaining effort on productive branches, but most models still behave much closer to unguided search algorithms than to neural-guided KataGo. Longer CoT or higher Token Efficiency does not necessarily imply better search. Our results identify search organization and reasoning-resource allocation as missing dimensions in LLM reasoning evaluation.
2608.13221.paper_summary_zh: LLM 推理的評估正從最終答案的準確性轉向過程層級的評估，然而現有的方法仍未能捕捉模型如何規劃推理路徑和分配推理資源——也就是說，它們如何組織搜索。先前的過程層級方法專注於思維鏈（CoT）的連貫性和冗餘性，而大多數基準任務只有一個可由靜態能力（如推導和工具使用）解決的單一目標，這使得搜索組織未被測量。我們引入 TsuGO，這是一個針對 LLM 推理中搜索效率的過程層級推理基準，通過圍棋的生死問題進行評估。這些問題提供了封閉且可驗證的解決空間，並具有內在的對抗結構，使得候選生成、回應檢查、分支比較和回溯成為推理的必要部分，而不是偶然的痕跡模式。通過限制解決空間，TsuGO 將領域知識與搜索組織分開，將 CoT 解析為結構化的搜索樹，並報告搜索效率以及標記效率和其他診斷指標和可視化。實驗顯示，目前的 LLM 在穩定解決 tsumego 方面仍然相距甚遠：更強的模型通過更早找到正確的候選並在有效分支上持續努力而成功，但大多數模型的行為仍然更接近於無指導的搜索算法，而非神經指導的 KataGo。較長的 CoT 或更高的標記效率並不一定意味著更好的搜索。我們的結果確定了搜索組織和推理資源分配是 LLM 推理評估中缺失的維度。
